title: Prince William may let daughter Charlotte give up royal titles; 11-year-old dreams of stage career
summary_full: Princess Charlotte could pursue a career in the performing arts, with reports suggesting she dreams of becoming an actress or singer. Prince William may reportedly allow his younger children to give up their royal titles and HRH styles when they become adults, giving Charlotte and Prince Louis the freedom to choose independent careers away from royal duties.
